text:
sam: Heads-up — I'm planning a small TF change to externalsecrets in staging at 11:00 to add lease jitter and a new annotation mapping. Need a quick sanity check on RBAC + rotation behavior.

devon: ping @maria — you own the vault bindings, right?

maria: yup, that's me. what's the PR?

sam: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4892 — changes in modules/externalsecrets: adds `lease_jitter`, maps `redwood.com/secret-path` -> `redwood.com/secret-paths`, and updates templates.

isha: quick note: the svcacct referenced in the module (externalsecret-sync-sa) doesn't have the vault read policy in staging yet, apply will fail.

lee: can we dry-run first? `terraform plan` then `kubectl apply --server-side --dry-run=client` for the manifest patch.

ops-bot: deploy-check: terraform plan completed with 2 issues in module "externalsecrets" — IAM binding missing; template annotation mismatch.

devon: what are the exact errors from the plan?

ops-bot: error 1: missing `vault_policy` binding for serviceAccount externalsecret-sync-sa in staging; error 2: template uses `redwood.com/secret-path` but cluster sync expects `redwood.com/secret-paths`.

maria: easy fixes — add binding in `vault_bindings.tf` and update the module's annotation key. I'll draft a tiny follow-up PR for the binding.

sam: can someone review #4895 (vault binding) today? this is blocking the staging rollout.

isha: I can review after stand (10:30).

lee: I'll add a CI smoke test that creates a demo ExternalSecret and verifies the Secret appears post-sync and after a simulated rotation. I'll put it in `ci/smoke/externalsecrets.sh`. Sample snippet:```bash
kubectl apply -f test/demo-externalsecret.yaml
sleep 10
kubectl get secret demo-secret -n staging
```

devon: follow-up: we should run a migration to rewrite old annotation keys in namespaces that still have the legacy `redwood.com/secret-path`. filing infra#1120 to track.

sam: created infra#1120 and assigned to devon.

maria: one more important thing re rotation: if Vault lease TTL < k8s Secret TTL we can briefly have missing data during rotation. We need to ensure Vault lease >= k8s TTL (or refresh semantics).

isha: agreed — propose `vault_lease_ttl = max(k8s_secret_ttl * 1.2, "1h")` in module defaults, and document it in the externalsecrets README.

sam: ops checklist for rollout: 1) merge vault binding PR 4895 2) update externalsecrets module annotation and bump module version 3) run migration job for old annotations 4) merge smoke test and run in staging 5) monitor sync metrics.

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:

devon: I'll push review comments and aim to merge binding by EOD.

sam: awesome — thanks all. I'll leave the PRs in draft until binding is merged, then un-draft and kick the apply. Ping here when ready.

lee: one small gotcha I noticed: the template uses `{{ .Data.value }}` in a couple places; if we change keys during migration we should keep backwards-compatible lookups or add fallback keys.

maria: good call — I'll add fallback rendering for both keys in the template.

ops-bot: reminder: scheduled secret-rotation job runs at 02:00 UTC; if you plan manual rotates, coordinate to avoid overlaps.

sam: noted. thanks — I'll schedule manual rotate at 12:30 UTC after smoke tests.

devon: marking infra#1120 as in-progress. will update timeline in the ticket.

sam: closing the loop here — will update this thread after staging apply.

maria: thanks everyone.
